status_label: DRAFT / OPEN / Ring 4 / NOT LICENSED / HELD
matrix_rule: A green bounded-software receipt may support only the exact software contract it exercises. It cannot establish empirical, causal, physical, material, safety, clinical, regulatory, product, canon, license, disclosure, authorship, or peer-review conclusions.

entries.statement: The CAS PCBA v8 Python candidate represents components, ports, signal kinds, units, parameters, nets, state literals, test points, calibration references, and feedback declarations with closed typed contracts.
entries.allowed_wording: The bound candidate implements and regression-tests the declared typed Python object model.
entries.prohibited_inference: Complete CCDL conformance, cognitive validity, physical circuit identity, or product readiness.

entries.statement: Complete declared board structure participates in an immutable canonical identity, and exact runtime value tags distinguish Boolean true, integer 1, and string true.
entries.allowed_wording: The bound software rejects the tested identity collisions and mutation cases.
entries.prohibited_inference: Cryptographic authenticity, reviewer identity, or authority from a self-hash.

entries.statement: The deterministic DRC checks declared component contracts, typed connectivity, driver count, required ports, signal/unit compatibility, calibration linkage, and test-point requirements and fails boards carrying errors.
entries.allowed_wording: The exact tested DRC contract is implemented for the admitted Python model.
entries.prohibited_inference: All invalid boards are detected or the checker is formally complete.

entries.statement: The DRC uses graph-cycle analysis and conservative per-cycle gain checks for declared feedback in the supported profile.
entries.allowed_wording: The supported software rejects tested undeclared, no-delay, and unsafe-gain cycles.
entries.prohibited_inference: Complete stateful, stochastic, analog, or safety feedback analysis.

entries.statement: For supported activation paths, the DRC reports an unreachable threshold when the derived upstream upper bound is below the declared fuse threshold.
entries.allowed_wording: The candidate diagnoses the bound CSB threshold contradiction as a known fault.
entries.prohibited_inference: The known-fault test validates a safety mechanism or repaired design.

entries.statement: The narrow reference simulator emits deterministic trace and measurement records bound to board, DRC, catalog, decimal-context, source, calibration, and child-lineage identities.
entries.allowed_wording: The bound software deterministically replays supported fixtures and checks their declared provenance contract.
entries.prohibited_inference: A trace proves an external cognitive mechanism, causal effect, measurement validity, or safety effect.

entries.statement: Only certified total finite deterministic stateless non-stochastic transition tables can cross the candidate TKS v8 adapter, and the certificate binds the exact kernel and PCBA identities.
entries.allowed_wording: The adapter certifies a narrow typed structural representation in the finite reference kernel.
entries.prohibited_inference: Automatic CAS semantic identity, canon admission, or representation of continuous/stateful dynamics.

entries.statement: The candidate keeps the mixed-simplex Fisher-Rao profile and optional projector profile type-distinct and binds projector matrix, rank, source/basis, tolerance, and validation residuals.
entries.allowed_wording: The candidate implements two separately named numerical geometry profiles.
entries.prohibited_inference: A projector profile is the canonical PCBA address or a validated latent cognitive subspace.
entries.theorem_authority: Formal Mathematics Paper 3 at commit 3c8491db6f5559cf090909d9de0efa03d924f53f and source-draft SHA-256 679E1119CB084D9A429F6FCC26374B18FF1FB6252D7374631975B4FF56BAEFC4; this engineering record is a read-only dependency summary.

entries.statement: The consolidated formal CCDL EBNF does not cover the published five-board reference corpus; four boards contain direct syntax counterexamples and one bounded listing has no direct counterexample established by this audit.
entries.allowed_wording: The audited corpus-level grammar-coverage claim fails.
entries.prohibited_inference: Every individual board is proven unparsable under every implementation.

entries.statement: Under the published clamp semantics, the CSB red stage capped at 0.1 cannot cross its downstream 0.9 fuse threshold; the same source also uses non-finite gain without complete latch/fail-closed semantics.
entries.allowed_wording: The unmodified CSB is a known-fault source fixture.
entries.prohibited_inference: The candidate proves a safe repair, hazard coverage, certification, or clinical suitability.

entries.statement: A complete versioned CCDL grammar, parser, canonical round trip, and corpus conformance package do not exist in the admitted candidate.
entries.allowed_wording: The v0.1 candidate exposes only its typed Python model.
entries.prohibited_inference: Complete CCDL compiler conformance.

entries.statement: Capacitor, PLL, memory, power, richer feedback, stochastic, and memristive time/state semantics remain unspecified or unvalidated.
entries.allowed_wording: Only the narrow declared deterministic profile and bounded within-run fuse state are implemented.
entries.prohibited_inference: Stateful or adaptive dynamics are already implemented.

entries.statement: No live PCBA calibration, authenticated instrumentation, environmental validity, uncertainty/drift validation, or held-out external result is admitted.
entries.allowed_wording: Calibration fields are structural/test metadata in this candidate.
entries.prohibited_inference: Calibrated measurement or external validity.

entries.statement: PCBA safety effectiveness, certification, regulatory compliance, and clinical suitability are not established.
entries.allowed_wording: All safety, clinical, and regulatory conclusions remain open.
entries.prohibited_inference: Any positive safety, certification, regulatory, or clinical claim.

entries.statement: The CAS-Ohm candidate keeps quantity kind, exact decimal, unit, measurement kind, method, calibration profile, uncertainty, sample size, lineage, raw evidence, controls, and missingness type-distinct.
entries.allowed_wording: The bound software enforces the tested measurement and provenance distinctions.
entries.prohibited_inference: A typed value is an authenticated measurement or physical telemetry.

entries.statement: Calibration profiles bind the declared model, direction, corpus, splits, methods, tolerances, controls, validity interval, drift, and digest; calibrated held-out resistance is distinguished from same-sample apparent resistance.
entries.allowed_wording: The software rejects tested circular same-sample prediction and profile/split mismatches.
entries.prohibited_inference: A live calibration or held-out predictive result exists.

entries.statement: Dose-response region and semantic outcome are independent classifications in the candidate.
entries.allowed_wording: No response region mechanically determines semantic correctness.
entries.prohibited_inference: ACTIVE means intended or NON_OHMIC means misaligned.

entries.statement: Q4 bands classify exact pre-clipping Q10 values using [0,2.5), [2.5,5), [5,7.5), and [7.5,infinity); the displayed q10 is clipped at 10 and overload_ratio is retained separately.
entries.allowed_wording: The candidate has an exact Q4 software classification rule.
entries.prohibited_inference: Q4 validates the selected full-scale method or semantic interpretation.

entries.statement: Series, parallel, and gain-product calculations are profile-, unit-, coordinate-, topology-, region-, child-, and provenance-gated structural research operations.
entries.allowed_wording: The software computes structural equivalents for admitted research fixtures.
entries.prohibited_inference: Network arithmetic is empirically valid, causal, physical, or authenticated.

entries.statement: Residual diagnosis is restricted to matching active, reviewed, replay-time-current held-out instrumented evidence with uncertainty and remains explicitly non-identifying; replay-time status uses caller-supplied replay_as_of and is not authenticated-current.
entries.allowed_wording: A residual may rank follow-up probes under the declared profile.
entries.prohibited_inference: Residual sign proves a hidden policy, bypass, opposition, or cause.

entries.statement: Structural research-packet completeness and authenticated Evidence Packet eligibility are separate; replay-time-current uses caller-supplied replay_as_of, while authenticated-current eligibility is false in the current candidate.
entries.allowed_wording: No authenticated capability or Evidence Packet path is admitted.
entries.prohibited_inference: A self-hash, fixture signature, or local replay time creates independent authority.

entries.statement: The three CAS-Ohm sources retain eight conflicts or under-specifications across scale/saturation, full-scale method, dimensional bridge, gain, ASOM, network rules, residual identification, and Q4 boundaries.
entries.allowed_wording: The candidate preserves eight exact source conflicts or under-specifications.
entries.prohibited_inference: The inherited sources already define one coherent scale, unit, gain, or network law.

entries.statement: For common-rank d > 0 finite-rank orthogonal projectors in one Hilbert space, normalized Hilbert-Schmidt overlap tr(P_i P_j)/d is a positive-semidefinite kernel in [0,1].
entries.allowed_wording: The registered standard kernel result is an optional geometry dependency under its stated assumptions.
entries.prohibited_inference: Strict positive definiteness, a rank-zero normalized kernel, latent cognitive validity, or capacity.

entries.statement: A proposed CAS projector-capacity specialization would require a CAS-specific representation satisfying every source hypothesis, including the omitted isometry/intertwining identity.
entries.allowed_wording: The capacity transfer is an open conjectural dependency.
entries.prohibited_inference: Any engineering or empirical capacity bound is established.

entries.statement: CAS-Ohm design scores, proxies, and model-derived quantities are physical electrical telemetry or validated measurements.
entries.allowed_wording: Current uninstrumented quantities are design values, scores, proxies, or model-derived values as typed; physical SI quantities are outside CAS-Ohm UnitKind, and generic PCBA Unit.VOLT does not license telemetry.
